response.rationale: R7 uniquely combines the confirmed MTB infection with the HLH syndrome supported by fever, cytopenias, hyperferritinemia, organomegaly, and marrow hemophagocytosis; R5 captures TB but misses HLH, while HLH-only candidates miss the positive MTB assay.
